items.name: MiniMax M3.1-Flash-Preview
items.summary: MiniMax has launched M3.1-Flash-Preview, a new-generation ultra-fast text model now live on MiniMax Code. Positioned for everyday development scenarios — quick bug fixes and complete feature implementation — with an emphasis on response speed and stability.

items.name: Arm AI Portal
items.summary: Arm launched a dedicated AI model portal for its 22 million developers, offering a library of pre-optimized models for language, voice, and video tasks with MCP-based agent access. Early benchmarks show Qwen3-TTS running over 4x faster on the Vivo X300 smartphone and YOLO26n gaining 40%+ on Raspberry Pi 5.

items.name: PrismML Bonsai 2 27B
items.summary: PrismML launched Bonsai 2 27B, a second-generation ultra-compact multimodal model that compresses a Qwen3.8 27B-class model from ~56GB to 5.9GB using ternary weight compression while retaining around 98.2% of its capabilities. Weights are available today under Apache 2.0, running locally on PCs and high-end mobile devices.

items.name: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber (reported)
items.summary: Fortune reports OpenAI is days away from previewing GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused model expected at DevDay on September 29 — which would be the company's fourth security-oriented model this year. OpenAI has not publicly confirmed the model; per the report, a limited group already has alpha access through the Daybreak Red program.

items.name: Qwen-Image-2.1
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B unified text-to-image generation and editing model with native transparent (RGBA) output and support for up to 10 reference images in a single edit. Unlike earlier Qwen-Image releases, it ships under a research-oriented license rather than Apache 2.0, limiting commercial use.
